entry.summary: Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz is launching a new program aimed at recent high school graduates and college dropouts that will identify and train young talent building artificial intelligence products.

entry.title: Ligent Technologies to Debut After $727 Million in Hong Kong IPO
